units.source_text: 连怕冷的名人也展开了扇子，神经质地扇了起来。

en.t: Even the Master, who was sensitive to the cold, opened his fan and began fanning himself nervously.

units.source_text: 我不忍心看他们两人的表情。

en.t: I could not bear to look at the expressions on the faces of the two of them.

units.source_text: 不大一会儿，名人如释重负，显得轻松了。

en.t: Before long, the Master seemed relieved, as though a weight had been lifted from him.
